Like all of my other games, I developed it in its entirety on my own as well as having had composed the soundtrack.

notes.title: HIKIBYOU2 - Vote on Greenlight!
notes.notes:
The sequel to this game, titled HIKIBYOU2, is currently on Greenlight for voting. Please do take a look at it through [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=782225137]here[/url].

HIKIBYOU2 is an action/adventure platfomer with puzzle and stealth elements. A bit of what differentiates itself from the first title in the series is this successor's less realistic approach and more atmospheric vibe. Levels are once again open-ended with the story directing the player.

Like all of my other games, I developed it in its entirety on my own.

notes.title: Update - Version 1.0.9.8
notes.notes:
This is a list of the changes that have been applied in this update:

- A few adjustments have been made to the wall-running function

- The achievement [i]Level 1 w/ Skill[/i] now requires completing the first level with less than five deaths rather than zero deaths

- The achievement [i]Level 2 w/ Skill[/i] now requires completing the second level with less than five deaths rather than zero deaths

- The achievement [i]Level 3 w/ Skill[/i] now requires completing the third level with less than five deaths rather than zero deaths

- The achievement [i]Level 4 w/ Skill[/i] now requires completing the fourth level with less than five deaths rather than zero deaths

- The achievement [i]Level 5 w/ Skill[/i] now requires completing the fifth level with less than five deaths rather than zero deaths
